title: Jamey Delaplane, NACD.DC (ex-Vanguard) joins the Long-Term Stock Exchange board: 'the only stock exchange redefining the role of capital markets'
summary: Jamey Delaplane — NACD.DC-certified board member; long career at Vanguard; financial services and policy expert — announces he's joining the Long-Term Stock Exchange (LTSE) board alongside CEO Maliz Beams. Frames LTSE, founded by Eric Ries, as the ecosystem for the first SEC-approved long-term listing principles, corporate reporting reforms, and mission-based governance advocacy. Governance-level news about Eric's other company.
blockquote: I'm thrilled to now be joining the board of another important company, the Long-Term Stock Exchange, working to encourage companies and #capitalmarkets toward the long view. LTSE is the business ecosystem helping visionary private and public companies drive long-term profit with purpose and impact. Founded by tech entrepreneur, management innovator, and best-selling author (The Lean Startup, Incorruptible), Eric Ries, LTSE is the only #stockexchange redefining the role of capital markets by structurally changing the rules to better support long-term #valuecreation.
attribution_title: Board Member · Ex-Vanguard · Financial Services & Policy Expert
